What stood out · what to do next

Highlights

WINLeads rose 12.1% while cost per lead fell 6.8%, so volume and efficiency improved together. Blended CPL is $27.56 against a $32 target.

WINEmail was the fastest-growing channel (+18% leads) at $10.69 CPL, helped by the mid-month nurture sequence and a cleaner list.

WATCHPaid social spend is 31.6% of the budget but only 19.2% of leads. CPL rose to $45.18 as prospecting frequency climbed.

RISKReferral and partners slipped 11% in leads and now cost $69.84 per lead — more than double the blended average.

Recommendations

  1. Shift ~8% of paid social budget into paid search brand and high-intent non-brand. Search still converts at 2.39% and has room before CPL approaches the social rate.
  2. Cap social prospecting frequency and rebuild lookalikes from October converters. Hold retargeting; it is carrying most of the channel’s efficient leads.
  3. Repeat the email nurture play in November and add one partner-sourced segment so the +18% lift is not a one-off.
  4. Review the three lowest-yield partner placements before renewing. Pause anything above $60 CPL unless it is feeding pipeline quality we cannot see in lead count.
Source: site analytics, ad platforms, and CRM lead log · figures rounded Prepared Nov 23, 2026 · internal use
